items.title: 6.10 Machine learning ke tools aur platforms (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Machine learning mein data analysis aur modeling ke liye mukhtalif tools istemal hote hain. Tools data jama, process aur analyze karne mein madad dete hain. Kuch tools saade aur naye seekhne walon (beginners) ke liye asaan hain, aur kuch advanced (aage ke) machine learning kaamon ke liye hain. Sahi tool chunna aham hai, kyunke har tool ki apni khoobiyan hain. Tools kaam ki efficiency aur accuracy barhate hain aur mazboot bunyad banate hain. Yeh platforms aaj ke data science ke kaam ko chalate hain. Machine learning ke tools aur platforms yeh hain:

items: Python aur Jupyter notebooks: machine learning ke liye

blocks.text: Using Excel for Data Analysis (Excel se data analysis)

Excel bunyadi data analysis ke liye bohat istemal hota hai; is mein data rows aur columns mein rakha jata hai. Excel mein sorting (tarteeb dena), filtering (sirf zaroori rows dikhana) aur charts se data visualization (data ko tasveer ki shakal mein dikhana) hoti hai. Charts data samajhne mein madad dete hain, aur saade formulas hisab karte hain. Excel seekhna asaan hai aur chhote datasets ke liye mufeed hai. Naye seekhne wale aksar Excel se shuru karte hain, aur yeh data ki ibtidai samajh deta hai.
Introduction to R for Data Science (R ka ta'aruf)

R data analysis ki programming language hai jo research (tehqeeq) mein bohat istemal hoti hai. Is mein data ko dikhane ke liye mazboot graphical tools (graph banane ke tools) hain. R bare datasets ko achhi tarah sambhalti hai, aur is ke bohat se packages (tayyar code ke majmue) data science ke kaam karte hain. R seekhne se analysis ki salahiyat barhti hai jo machine learning ki bunyad mein kaam aati hai.
Python and Jupyter Notebooks for Machine Learning (Python aur Jupyter)

Python machine learning ki maqbool programming language hai. Is ki bohat si mufeed libraries (tayyar code ke majmue) hain, jaise Pandas aur NumPy; Python data analysis aur modeling dono mein kaam aati hai. Jupyter notebooks interactive environment (aisa mahol jahan code chala kar foran nateeja dekhein) dete hain: code aur us ke results ek hi notebook mein saath nazar aate hain. Is se ek interactive Integrated Development Environment (IDE) mein code seekhna aur test karna asaan hota hai. Python advanced machine learning bhi karti hai aur industry mein bohat istemal hoti hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: 6.6 wala regression program Python mein hai aur NumPy, matplotlib (graph ke liye) aur scikit-learn (sklearn, machine learning models ke liye) libraries istemal karta hai. Aam tarteeb: Excel se data samjhein, R se statistics aur graphs, aur Python se machine learning models.

blocks.prompt: Aap kaun sa tool chunenge (a) class ke marks ka jaldi chart banane ke liye, (b) grades ka andaza lagane wala model train karne ke liye? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: (a) Excel: chhote tables asaani se sort aur chart hote hain. (b) Python (maslan Jupyter notebook mein) scikit-learn jaisi libraries ke saath, jo tayyar machine learning models deti hain.

items: Excel: rows aur columns, sorting, filtering, charts; chhote data aur beginners ke liye.
R: research mein data analysis, mazboot graphics, bare datasets, packages.
Python aur Jupyter: libraries (Pandas, NumPy), code aur results saath; advanced machine learning.
